consolidacion.inserted_dw.interpretation: inserted_academico + inserted_financiero; admission outcomes excluded. Loaded outcomes may insert or update, so this is not a count of newly persisted rows.
consolidacion.inserted_dw.denominator_basis: Constant1 expresses a count; no compatible population denominator is established. Do not divide by ingestion records, facts or review cases.

consolidacion.inserted_academico.unit: loaded outcomes in broad academic API bucket
consolidacion.inserted_academico.interpretation: Loaded non-financial/non-admission outcomes: includes academic, teacher evaluation, profitability and marketing routes; not just fact_rendimiento_academico.
consolidacion.inserted_academico.denominator_basis: Constant1 expresses a count; no compatible population denominator is established. Do not divide by ingestion records, facts or review cases.

consolidacion.inserted_financiero.interpretation: One increment per loader result loaded with tipo financiero; not a distinct persisted-row count.
consolidacion.inserted_financiero.denominator_basis: Constant1 expresses a count; no compatible population denominator is established. Do not divide by ingestion records, facts or review cases.

consolidacion.inserted_admision.interpretation: Admission route may update a student or aggregated marketing record; excluded from inserted_dw.
consolidacion.inserted_admision.denominator_basis: Constant1 expresses a count; no compatible population denominator is established. Do not divide by ingestion records, facts or review cases.

consolidacion.inserted_revision.unit: loaded reg_item outcomes flagged for review at caller
consolidacion.inserted_revision.interpretation: Increments after status loaded when reg_item.calidad.requiere_revision. Loader may independently force review (e.g. missing date); repeated updates/expansion also prevent equality with persisted requires_review rows.
consolidacion.inserted_revision.denominator_basis: Constant1 expresses a count; no compatible population denominator is established. Do not divide by ingestion records, facts or review cases.

consolidacion.sent_hitl.unit: API HITL path increments (mixed line/outcome granularity)
consolidacion.sent_hitl.interpretation: Increments per non-loaded expanded reg_item, or per unapproved input line. Not the number of staging rows, distinct people or review-tray cases.
consolidacion.sent_hitl.denominator_basis: Constant1 expresses a count; no compatible population denominator is established. Do not divide by ingestion records, facts or review cases.

consolidacion.descartados_ruido.unit: nonempty consolidation input lines discarded for semantic noise
consolidacion.descartados_ruido.interpretation: One increment before loading when motivo_fila_sin_entidad is nonempty; applies to queried staging blocks with es_ruido FALSE. Not a fact-row count.
consolidacion.descartados_ruido.denominator_basis: Constant1 expresses a count; no compatible population denominator is established. Do not divide by ingestion records, facts or review cases.

carga.archivos_exitosos.denominator_basis: Constant1 expresses a count; ingestion records are not a proven denominator for expanded consolidation outcomes or semantic-noise line counts.

carga.archivos_fallidos.denominator_basis: Constant1 expresses a count; ingestion records are not a proven denominator for expanded consolidation outcomes or semantic-noise line counts.

warning: Only same frozen F0 population is compared. a3→a123 is combined options1+2. Reading/consolidation, API outcomes, persisted requires_revision rows, staging rows and review-tray cases/groups are separate units and are never summed or forced to reconcile. Count/1 is used when no compatible denominator is proven. Pending A3/A4 human validation is independent of these arithmetic contrasts.
